name: Sonner
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: `role="region"` -- defines the notification area as a named landmark section
`aria-label={label}` -- provides an accessible name identifying the notification area
`aria-live="polite"` -- ensures new content is announced after the screen reader finishes its current output
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `label`: string (required) -- accessible name identifying the notification area, applied via `aria-label`
